description.en: Plays a sound handle opened with one of the CMND_SND_OPEN_* commands, optionally at a given volume and with a fade-in.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Play a BGM handle at full volume with a fade-in
CMND_SND_PLAY(hBGM, 1.0, _fade);
